cover.headline: The numbers line, decoded
cover.sub: Why labels wait for you to build the audience, and why that audience is your leverage.

blocks.text: Labels want artists who already have **the audience, the data and the sales**. You do the early work.
Track your own numbers: list size, presale orders, repeat buyers. Not just streams.
Fans who buy from you directly are worth more than a deal that pays you **a share of them**.
Before any meeting, know how many fans you can reach without a platform.
If you can sell out a presale alone, you can ask for **a license, a shorter term or a bigger share**. Or skip the deal.
Write down what a partner adds that you can't do yourself. Sign only for that.

rows.text: Start the list and a signup offer
Run a presale on your next release
Decide if you need a label at all

blocks.text: Keep every fan's contact in a tool you own, whatever deal comes next.
